semantic_contract.runtime: Enabled quiet window blocks when schedule matcher is true. Inclusive start/end; same-day start<=end or overnight start>end. Day is current local weekday. Invalid IANA timezone silently falls back to America/Bogota; malformed HH:MM uses fallback and numeric hours/minutes clamp.
semantic_contract.global_scope: All enabled all/channel and all/entity_type matching rows are considered; first blocked row blocks. No specificity override.
semantic_contract.effects: Immediate triggers skip events; remarketing defers by retry_minutes; delayed triggers defer30min on global quiet only.
semantic_contract.preflight: Nonempty start/end/day configuration check, not valid HH:MM/IANA or current-time eligibility.

semantic_contract.stability: No entity id/version/experiment salt in hash; same recipient bucket across entities. Config changes can change selected variant.
semantic_contract.override: Selected template_id/reply_text patches every action before type dispatch. Flow-level selected template can replace the template in every flow step.
semantic_contract.preflight: Enabled requires variants (medium). Supplied template ids must exist draft/approved (high). Total weight<=0 or80..120 accepted (low).

semantic_contract.outcome: queued if result.ok else failed. Successful non-send/scheduled actions can yield queued with no outbound id.
semantic_contract.report: Groups variant_key/template_id ->events/queued/failed/last_seen_at. No provider delivery/read/reply/conversion measurement.
semantic_contract.version_step: Recorder has no dedicated version or flow step identity field.

crm_bridge.transport: C10 native chat queue/media; P7 remains the separate official Meta template path.
crm_bridge.current_composition: Body/text/heading/link parts plus native image/audio/video/document attachments. Uploaded library asset or bounded public URL is selected explicitly. Each prepared part has a message, queue operation, part_index and attempt event.
crm_bridge.template_version_and_channel: Explicit CRM template id/version and A/B contract; template/account channel must match flow. Uploaded asset metadata no longer shadows template variables.

image_builder.current_local_behavior: Native C10 mediaId attachments, including uploaded image/audio/video/document blocks. Images are no longer link-only.
image_builder.historical_link_only_claim: superseded and resolved locally by reviewed source; does not imply full provider acceptance

asset_upload_download.upload: Strict image/video/audio/document request, base64 validation, operation replay, file-byte cap, typed inspection and content-kind agreement, institution storage budget and durable template_asset event.
asset_upload_download.private_library: library_file checks institution event, actor ownership or saved-template reference, real nonsymlink path, exact size and SHA256. Download executes service.tx(auth), returns attachment with no-store/CSP sandbox/nosniff.
asset_upload_download.preview: UI explicitly fetches authenticated same-origin asset endpoint, builds/revokes object URL and renders image/audio/video or document download. No file URL containing a token is added by this component.
asset_upload_download.microphone: getUserMedia invoked only by record button handler; MediaRecorder uploads after stop. Stops tracks/timer/object URLs on cleanup. Stops at5MB or300000ms and offers upload when microphone unsupported.

public_asset_acquisition.request: HTTPS only/no credentials/non443 port/fragment, all DNS answers global, selected IP socket fixed with original hostname verified TLS; only200/no redirects and identity content encoding.
public_asset_acquisition.bounds: Content-Length and streamed bytes capped by files.MAX_BYTES, 30s streamed duration, empty/truncated data rejected. Downloaded/attempt-copy content is re-inspected by typed inspector and bound to C10 message/conversation/integration/user after live step revalidation.

limits.audio_storage: Ogg/Opus normalization; AAC/MP4 send variant for Messenger/Instagram
limits.video_storage: MP4/H264/AAC, one video and at most one audio stream; inspected/transcoded with file/pipe-only subprocesses and timeouts.
limits.document_limit_note: Typed inspectors reject unsupported/active/malformed documents; filename/MIME alone is not acceptance.
limits.tiktok: Text allowed separately; media only image. Native image adapter further requires<=3000000bytes and media body empty, confirmed conversation type and IMAGE_SEND capability. Audio/video/document rejected before enqueue.
limits.instagram: Direct Instagram Login media now has a P8-only signed-URL attachment branch, plus existing Facebook/Page upload path. Requires configured PublicBaseUrl and valid live binding; external Meta validation remains pending.

block_delays.ui_and_schema: Builder edits seconds0..300 ->delay_ms; strict model bounds0..300000.
block_delays.persistence: First part uses run.DueAt+delay; next part uses prior CompletedAt (or now)+delay; retry retains prior DueAt. planned=max(now,previous_due) written to C10 SendJob.DueAt; ready rejects future DueAt.
block_delays.social_caption_timing: Delay applies before media; following caption text part has delay0 and its own message/queue/attempt identity.

social_caption_filename_corrections.caption: Non-WhatsApp media part body empty, followed by separate text part when caption nonempty. This avoids silently discarding Instagram/Messenger captions and satisfies TikTok empty-media-body rule.
social_caption_filename_corrections.filename: Document attach_copy inspection uses part.filename when supplied, preserving the edited block filename through native asset name/provider document naming.
social_caption_filename_corrections.shadow: Uploaded asset metadata uses variable asset; template value remains available for rendering later blocks.
social_caption_filename_corrections.quota: Campaign asset quota combines library template_asset sizes with live native MediaAsset sizes, delegates native per-conversation quota.
social_caption_filename_corrections.status: observed_in_current_source; SQL-caption qualification was pending in prior principal update; new six-check delivery qualification reported running, not independently inspected.

part_retry_semantics.source_fact: next_part requires accepted/sent/delivered/read of prior part; retry requires definitive failed without ExternalId; unstarted cancelled work may be reprepared. Index advances only for next_part; retry retains part index and due time, maximum20attempts/part.
part_retry_semantics.limits: These source guards are not an independent runtime proof of full coordinator/dispatcher idempotency or pause behavior.

official_meta.transport: P7 official template transport, separate from CRM blocks
official_meta.typed_separation: A send step chooses CRM or Meta contract exclusively; A/B contracts must match. No CRM local approval is turned into provider approval.

reported_sql_context.provenance: Explicit principal-agent task message; not a SQL proof file inspected or run by this subagent
reported_sql_context.interpretation: Principal reports three parts accepted once each and one image cancelled without POST on pause, with preservation. Does not establish delivery/read, live provider acceptance, all-channel behavior or phase closure.

reported_test_context_update.provenance: Principal-agent message only, not tests or proof inspected/executed here
reported_test_context_update.principal_report: Pure parameterized four-channel and quota tests added after corrections. Principal now reports tools.qualify_p8_delivery.py with six SQL checks running; no result read or executed by this semantic subagent.

remaining_unverified_differences: Actual external Meta permissions, public URL reachability, provider delivery/read receipts and institutional/live provider acceptance remain pending; source branches and signed URL installation do not prove them.
General5MB upload cap narrows to3MB for TikTok image media; audio/video/document unsupported there. Captions use a separate text part.
Heading/link blocks compose text/URLs, not provider-native heading/buttons. No interactive-message equivalence claimed.

Principal-reported pure tests and earlier three accepted parts/paused image are reported context only; six-check SQL delivery qualification reported running has no independently inspected result here.

supersedes.reason: Current source now implements image/audio/video/document upload/recording/download/preview, native parts, persisted delays and caption/filename corrections.

media_only_preview.source_fact: content validates parts then uses display markers [kind] if the rendered text is empty. prepare message fallback uses kind-specific image/audio/video/document markers. No audio caption is manufactured; Block rejects audio text.

instagram_login_delivery.source_reference_contrast: Scentra supports Instagram Login media through URL attachments on graph.instagram.com. CBN now has a matching P8-origin URL-attachment branch using a restricted signed retrieval URL, with social captions kept as separate C10 text parts.
instagram_login_delivery.construction: C10 outbound processing adds media.public_url only for P8 ticket version, origin campaign and Instagram Login adapter. delivery_url appends /hooks/campaign-media/{media}/{queue}?expires&sig to configured PublicBaseUrl, expires now+600seconds.
